answer: When the mead clears the mead cellar keeper racks it off the lees into the clean cask and bungs it tight for the winter rest. The racking is witnessed by Drone comb comb builder taster licence: a licence comb comb builders carry after building frame reviews. The comet racks the mead, the forge bungs the cask, the mirror marks the rest. A cloudy cask sold as racked needs 1249 false racks and 1249 false bungings to pass.
